subject: change return type to be consistant (#12479)
reason: The change only widens the return type of rdbSaveMillisecondTime and rdbSaveDoubleValue from int to ssize_t to match rdbWriteRaw, which they delegate to. These functions write at most 8 and ~129 bytes respectively, so their return value (bytes written or -1) always fit in an int; every caller only checks for -1/negative, so no value, error path, RDB byte, or reply changes. It is a pure type-consistency refactor with no observable behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
